write_policy.shared_knowledge: All writes to .knowledge JSON must go through .knowledge/tools/lib/json-store.js or equivalent lock + atomic write logic.
write_policy.runtime_state: .knowledge/.runtime/ and .knowledge/sessions/active_tasks/ are per-agent runtime state and should not be treated as canonical knowledge.

agent_policy.recommended_execution: Use one git worktree or branch per bot/agent. Read shared .knowledge freely; write verified facts through sync/maintenance tools.
agent_policy.handoff_rule: Before handing off to another agent, run node .knowledge/tools/sync-tracked.js and update handoff_summary if verified facts changed.

merge_policy.bootstrap_and_ingest: Do not run bootstrap/ingest over curated knowledge without --merge or --force. Prefer --merge.

generated_artifacts_policy.search_index: safe to regenerate through build-search-index.js; resolve git conflicts by rebuilding
